saw_lines: Gut supplement buyers pick one goal, like digestion or weight, then reorder monthly and rarely switch once a routine is set.
So the first line decides it: a buyer who sees weight loss promised with no proof or shipping answer keeps scrolling.
Your 21 of 26 copy ads open on one weight loss line, so test three new openers from Dailybacs Women and your daily routine against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: 21 of your 26 copy ads open on the same weight loss line, so new buyers hear one message only. Build three new openers from your Dailybacs Women formula, your daily routine, your capsule collection, and test each against it.

Your shipping policy page explains delivery, yet 0 of your 30 ads mention shipping, so first buyers must search for it. Open three ads for new buyers with a shipping line from that page, stating how and when orders arrive.
One exact copy runs in 19 of your 26 copy ads, so most of your copy is one script. Keep that body text, but change the opening line and the creative in each of the 19 ads.

None of your 30 ads shows a proof number, and the copy claims scientific proof with nothing to back it. Collect one real count, such as reviews or orders shipped, and lead with it in the first line of three ads.
